title: Juicy Malaysian Lamb Curry
description: A peppery and tender Malaysian dish featuring lamb shanks cooked in a clay pot, perfect for a brunch mood. This dish is a dash-friendly recipe that combines the flavors of Malaysia with the comfort of a hearty curry.
instructions: Heat the oil in the clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb shanks and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the coconut milk, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
